authorization: Report two scores per contestant, both pre-declared now in the freeze record before TEST scoring: (a) strict, where any output-limit hit is an error; (b) product-final, the verdict each product actually returns to a user, including its own built-in fallback. Same rule for both contestants. The headline is (a).
strict: For each contestant and item, any confirmed output-limit completion used by its execution makes the item an error (wrong), even if a later fallback returns a verdict. Other missing or unparsed final verdicts remain errors. No returned answer is retried.
productFinal: Use the untouched final per-item verdict returned by the frozen product runner, including its built-in fallback. Other missing or unparsed final verdicts remain errors.
limitEvidence: API completion metadata truncated=true or finishReason length/MAX_TOKENS/max_tokens
Native CLI JSON result explicitly reports the output-token maximum was exceeded
attribution: Reconstruct each recorded request fingerprint by free replay of frozen prompt functions. Join provider receipts to contestant, item and step. Reused limited outputs affect every consuming item.
counts: Separate per-model and per-contestant columns: number of observed completion envelopes hitting an output limit and number of affected items, with TEST and all-phase counts kept separate. Native internal retries are not inferred from aggregate num_turns.
unknownCauses: Do not infer output-limit hits from generic historical errors or timeouts. Report unclassified errors separately.
statistics: Apply the frozen exact McNemar, Wilson rates and request-cluster bootstrap to both score variants. The headline strict endpoint is supplied for the prespecified 18-cell Holm family; product-final is secondary.
coverage: Known output-limit, parse and exhausted no-answer errors are measured outcomes and remain in the denominator. A stopped execution is provisional; valid-verdict coverage is reported separately.
costAccounting: Known native error fees are included in the affected contestant unique-prompt cost. Unknown charges are disclosed separately, including a conservative budget hold.
nativeLimitCaveat: Native truncated=true can indicate a turn or budget limit; only explicit output-token evidence counts as an output-limit error.
